context_map.exchanged_information: Ingress Packets carrying 1Hz Telemetry Samples with t_device from edge devices, bike computers and wearables.
context_map.boundary_protection: Device payload shape is adopted as-is; Sensor Metric Boundary validation at intake tags VALIDATION_FAILED without dropping payload. Device firmware internals never leak in.
Only versioned published events cross; raw append-only storage, validation and reorder rules never leak. Distribution holds derived non-authoritative buffers only.

context_map.exchanged_information: TelemetryWindowBroadcast to downstream streaming analytics consumers (PulseStream Engine).
context_map.boundary_protection: Backpressure-aware demand-driven delivery; consumers receive windowed broadcast events only, never raw storage access.

cross_boundary_flows.notes: Producer appends then publishes; consumer must be idempotent per (device, metric, t_device, revision) with retry on failure. Ambiguity flagged: retry vs revision identity and delivery posture unstated.
Reordered within 60s window by t_device; packets later than window unspecified (open question). Corrections append revisions, never mutate.
Slow consumers handled by Reactive Stream Backpressure. Flag: Distribution may merge into Ingestion (low confidence). No coupling cycles; all flows one-directional.
